mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_relation (id, user_id, to_user_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{toUserId}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = IF(status = 1, #{updatedAt}, updated_at), status = IF(status = 1, 0, status);
mapper.select: select count(*) from user_relation as ur where ur.user_id = #{id} and ur.status = 0
select count(*) from user_relation as ur where ur.to_user_id = #{id} and ur.status = 0

select user.avatar_url, user.username, user.id from `user` inner join (select ur2.`user_id` from ( select ur1.to_user_id, ur1.updated_at from user_relation as ur1 where ur1.user_id = #{userId} and ur1.status = 0 order by ur1.updated_at DESC limit 0, 10) as ur1_temp INNER JOIN user_relation ur2 ON ur1_temp.to_user_id = ur2.user_id AND #{userId} = ur2.to_user_id AND ur2.status = 0) as ur_temp on `user`.id = ur_temp.`user_id`

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM user_relation ur1 INNER JOIN user_relation ur2 ON ur1.user_id = ur2.to_user_id AND ur1.to_user_id = ur2.user_id WHERE ur1.user_id = #{id} AND ur1.status = 0 AND ur2.status = 0) AS temp;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_relation r1 JOIN user_relation r2 ON r1.user_id = #{userId} AND r1.to_user_id = #{otherUserId} AND r2.user_id = #{otherUserId} AND r2.to_user_id = #{userId} WHERE r1.status = 0 AND r2.status = 0 AND r1.deleted_at IS NULL AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL
